info.title: BioAvanceD API
info.description: BioAvanceD backend API (RNF006 C2, #1325). This spec covers only the mounts listed in x-covered-mounts; the rest of the API is not yet documented here. Every response body is JSON with a boolean success; a failure carries error and, often, message. Outside the test environment every route sits behind the global rate limiter and /api/auth also behind the auth limiter, and a request over either limit answers 429.

entityType.description: The ingestion target. One the ingestion does not support, or one stored outside MongoDB, answers 422.

payload.description: The record, in the target's canonical shape.

provenance.description: The provenance envelope; a missing field quarantines the record.

idempotencyKey.description: A repeated key answers the first call's outcome again.

200.description: An idempotent replay of an accepted record: the first call's result.

201.description: Accepted and persisted, with its outbox event.

403.description: requireRole(3, 4) refused, or error INGESTION_OUT_OF_SCOPE: a field of the record is outside the caller's organization scope.

422.description: error INGESTION_QUARANTINED: the record is quarantined and details lists each violation, also on the replay of a quarantined key; or error INGESTION_TARGET_UNSUPPORTED, INGESTION_STORE_UNSUPPORTED or BARCODE_PERSONAL_DATA.

500.description: error INGESTION_FAILED: an unexpected failure, audited.

503.description: The database is not available, or error CANONICAL_RELEASE_NOT_ACTIVE: the canonical model release in force is absent or not active.

post.summary: Open a temperature incident, or add to the one open for the sensor
post.description: Gates: none. The route registers no authenticate and no permission, so this operation is unauthenticated. The incident and quarantine answer at the top level, not under data. It does not open the request database (req.app.locals.db), so it never answers 503. An open, acknowledged or escalated incident for the sensorKey is updated; otherwise one is created and the alert recipients are mailed.

200.description: The incident, and the outcome of the cold-chain quarantine.

get.summary: One nonconformance (RF025)

bearerAuth.description: Authorization: Bearer <access token>, the token login and refresh return.

items.description: A text, or a coded concept { text } or { coding }.

postRetentionAction.description: Only archive is accepted for AuditEvent.

archiveRetentionPeriod.description: An ISO 8601 duration no shorter than retentionPeriod; with archiveRetentionBasis, only for postRetentionAction archive.

archiveRetentionBasis.description: The legal or regulatory obligation the archive period rests on.

AccessPolicyInput.description: One version of an access policy. The five array fields of applicableEntityTypes, roleCodes, organizationScopeIds, resourceScopes and conditions must be non-empty. An accessPolicyId in the body is ignored.

items.description: A non-empty object of fact -> required value; the facts are consent, duo, study, organizationId, studyId, protocolId, requestedPurpose and duoCode.

NotificationRuleInput.description: A notification rule. A version in the body is ignored: the server numbers it (v1, v2, ...).

sensitiveFieldsAllowlist.description: The payload fields a message may carry; empty or absent means none.

active.description: Defaults to true; an active rule deactivates the other active rules of its eventType.

BadRequest.description: Invalid or missing input, or the operation failed.

Unauthorized.description: No, invalid or expired token or session, or an inactive account; on login, refused credentials.

Forbidden.description: Access denied: the permission or role gate refused, the role assignment expired, or MFA setup is pending.

UnprocessableEntity.description: Validation failed; details lists each reason.
